pages.text: Only bosses drop these. Simply Swords uniques are the best weapons in the pack. You cannot craft them, trade for them or find them in chests, and each one is matched to its boss's theme.$(br2)$(bold){{uniques kind=sword count}} swords and {{uniques kind=bow count}} bows$() are spread across all four tiers. A boss drops its unique on {{uniques dropped=yes minchance}} to {{uniques dropped=yes maxchance}} of kills.

pages.title: Building Around One
pages.text: Uniques have no enchanting penalty: Apotheosis enchanting and affix reforging both work on them. A unique with excellent affixes and level 5 enchants is the strongest item in the pack.$(br2)$(bold)Next: pick a target from $(l:icraft:bosses/t2_bosses)Tier 2 Bosses$(/l) and go earn one.$()
